title: Return Share on Insured-Requested Cancellation by Cardinal Tenure, Cardinal Personal Auto Policy Rate Page
content:
On a cancellation of a Cardinal Personal Auto Policy at the named insured's request, the return share follows the named insured's Cardinal tenure together with the lapse marker on the policy record.

## Rate

| Cardinal tenure, whole months to the cancellation date | Lapse marker on the policy record | Return share |
|---|---|---|
| 60 months or more | None | 100 percent: the full pro rata return |
| 12 months or more but under 60 | None | 95 percent |
| Any other combination | | 90 percent |

**Tenure.** Counted in whole months from the policy's original inception date to the cancellation date.

**Lapse marker.** A cancellation effective date kept on a reinstated policy marks a lapse. Any lapse marker, whatever its date, places the policy in the 90 percent line.

## Combinations (hypothetical)

| Tenure | Lapse marker | Return share |
|---|---|---|
| 72 months | None | 100 percent |
| 60 months | None | 100 percent |
| 59 months | None | 95 percent |
| 12 months | None | 95 percent |
| 11 months | None | 90 percent |
| 72 months | Present | 90 percent |
| 30 months | Present | 90 percent |
